name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source double-entry accounting with invoicing, bills, inventory and financial reports, backed by MariaDB, Redis and Gotenberg for PDF printing.

alerts.message: No account exists on first start: open the app and sign up to create the first user and organization. Sign-up stays open to anyone until you set SIGNUP_DISABLED to true.
User invites and password resets need SMTP (MAIL_* variables), and document attachments need an external S3-compatible bucket (S3_* variables). Both are empty by default.
